messages:
deploy-bot: initiating staged rollout v2.7.1 -> 5% traffic in eu-west and ap-south (change window 22:00-23:00 UTC)
janet: spotting p95 increase in eu-west, ~120ms over baseline on a small sample, sending snapshots
miguel: looking at ingress traces now, seeing repeated TLS handshake retries from two edge gateways
sre-oncall: recommend pausing eu-west until we confirm source — can we drop eu-west to 0% and pin to v2.7.0?
owen: agree with a regional pin for eu-west, leave ap-south alone for now
janet: quick comparison shows tokenizer differences in request parsing with v2.7.1, some prompts truncated
miguel: stack shows tokenizer.vocab lookup mismatch at parse stage, reproducing locally with test prompts
janet: @deploy-bot please hold eu-west and pin back to stable, commands below:
```
redwoodctl rollout update --region eu-west --traffic 0
redwoodctl rollout pin --region eu-west --version v2.7.0 --reason "suspected tokenizer parsing regression"
```
deploy-bot: running: `redwoodctl rollout update --region eu-west --traffic 0`
deploy-bot: eu-west traffic set to 0% (op id: tx-9821)
deploy-bot: running: `redwoodctl rollout pin --region eu-west --version v2.7.0`
deploy-bot: pinned eu-west -> v2.7.0 (pin id: pin-1789) :white_check_mark:
sre-oncall: plan: pin now, execute eu-west smoke suite (inference + kv-cache + tokenizer sanity). If green: keep pinned and schedule patch build for v2.7.1; if fail: escalate and prepare full rollback docs
janet: starting smoke tests (short run), ETA ~4m
devex: heads-up: drafting a one-line release-note addendum: "EU canary paused; working on tokenizer regression"
miguel: created INF-4321 with logs, repro steps, and failing snippet; assigning to @tokenizer_lead
janet: smoke tests finished locally — basic sanity passed but infra-side checks pending before any resume
tokenizer-team-bot: acknowledged INF-4321, assigning to sarah.tokenizer for investigation
owen: after we have infra pass, we can let ap-south continue to 10% if no signals; keep eu-west pinned until patch arrives
sre-oncall: marking this as a STOP for eu-west (stop/go status: STOP). monitoring other regions closely
devex: will prepare support playbook note and short customer message draft if we need to widen pause
miguel: discovered edge gateway version skew causing handshake retries in combination with new tokenizer headers; investigating whether rollout triggered different header shapes
janet: adding to ticket: header shape + tokenizer interaction. ETA for patch branch: 2-3 hours if fix repro is straightforward
deploy-bot: reminder: pinned regions require manual unpin or explicit resume: `redwoodctl rollout resume --region eu-west`
janet: will follow up once tokenizer owner posts patch PR and infra smoke is green; leaving channel for updates
sre-oncall: thanks everyone — keeping an eye on ap-south and global metrics.
